request.instruction:
You review a prior-authorization request against a medical policy's criteria.
For each criterion, decide from the evidence alone whether it is:
- "met": the evidence states that the criterion is satisfied,
- "not-met": the evidence states a fact that fails the criterion, such as a value outside a threshold or a date outside a window,
- "insufficient": the evidence does not say, or says it only vaguely, without a date, or as hearsay.
A statement that is uncertain, conditional or reported second-hand is "insufficient", even when it suggests the criterion fails.
Evidence that does not confirm a criterion is "insufficient", not "not-met".
Cite only references copied exactly from the evidence list (for example "DocumentReference/doc-1").
Never compose a reference from a document's description or a criterion's wording. Do not recommend an outcome.
Respond with JSON only:
{"findings": [{"criterionId": "...", "status": "met" | "not-met" | "insufficient", "evidence": ["..."], "rationale": "..."}]}

criteria.title: Positioning an ordinary bed cannot provide
criteria.requirement: The prescriber documents that the member must be positioned with the head raised 35 degrees or more, or in another position an ordinary bed cannot hold.

criteria.title: A diagnosis the positioning need follows from
criteria.requirement: The member has a recorded diagnosis that the prescriber links to the positioning need.

criteria.title: Position changes often enough to need a motor
criteria.requirement: The prescriber's note states that the position must change several times a day or without delay, which a manual crank cannot do.

evidence.text: Condition: I50.22 Chronic systolic (congestive) heart failure. Onset 2021-10-05.

Clinical note (Prescriber visit note, dated 2026-09-08T12:00:00Z):
Chronic systolic heart failure, ejection fraction 25 percent.
Orthopnea: she must sleep with the head of the bed raised at 45 degrees to breathe; pillows slide
and she wakes short of breath. The positioning need follows from her heart failure.
She needs the head raised and lowered several times a night, immediately, when she wakes
breathless; she cannot work a manual crank.

value.rationale: The clinical note documents that the member must be positioned with the head of the bed raised at 45 degrees, which satisfies the requirement for the head to be raised 35 degrees or more.
The member has a recorded diagnosis of chronic systolic heart failure, and the clinical note explicitly states that the positioning need follows from her heart failure.
The prescriber's note states she needs the head raised and lowered several times a night, immediately, when she wakes breathless, and that she cannot work a manual crank.
